name: wago-website
description: A wonderfully quick, compact, and extensible WebAssembly runtime for Go

scripts.build: npm run sync:check && tsc && rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && cp -r index.html assets data v0 facts.md compatibility.md security.md benchmarks.md CNAME robots.txt sitemap.xml site.webmanifest llms.txt llms-full.txt dist/
scripts.sync: node scripts/sync-stats.mjs && node scripts/sync-schema.mjs && node scripts/sync-facts.mjs && node scripts/sync-ai-metadata.mjs
scripts.sync:check: node scripts/sync-stats.mjs --check && node scripts/sync-schema.mjs --check && node scripts/sync-facts.mjs --check && node scripts/sync-ai-metadata.mjs --check
